title: Source Finder
description: Makes source blocks (water and lava sources) instantly distinguishable at a glance , a must for PVP.
body:
# 💧 SourceFinder

Never second-guess a water or lava source block again. **SourceFinder** is a lightweight resource pack designed for **PvP players**, making **source blocks** and **flowing blocks** instantly distinguishable at a glance.

## ✨ Features

* 🌊 Retextures all **4 vanilla fluid textures**.
* 👀 Easily tells **source blocks** apart from **flowing blocks**.
* ⚔️ Ideal for PvP, speedrunning, and fast-paced gameplay.
* 🚀 Lightweight design with **no FPS impact**.

> Spot the source instantly—without sacrificing performance.
